title: Textbook Generation Pipeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Intelligent Textbooks
AI Agent Skills
Textbook Generation Pipeline
Quality Gates
description: Clickable left-to-right flowchart of the ordered stages that turn a course description into a published textbook: course description, learning graph, chapter structure, chapter content, media and MicroSims, and deployment, with two quality gates that send work back when a check fails. Previous and Next buttons step through the pipeline, and each node shows its definition and the skill that performs it.

educational.topic: The textbook generation pipeline and its quality gates
learningObjectives: Summarize the ordered stages of the textbook generation pipeline.
Identify where human review and quality gates sit within the pipeline.
Explain why a failed quality gate sends work back to the stage before it.
prerequisites: Has read the definitions of agentic workflow, human in the loop, and quality gate

controls.label: Previous
controls.description: Moves the selection back one step in pipeline order

controls.label: Next
controls.description: Moves the selection forward one step in pipeline order

controls.label: Flowchart node
controls.description: Each of the eight nodes has a Mermaid click directive that shows its definition and the skill that performs it in the shared infobox

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: The learner steps through the stages in order and reads one concrete definition at a time instead of watching an animation
keyQuestions: Which stage does each quality gate send work back to?
Why is the graph checked before any chapter is designed?
commonMisconceptions: Validation is a single check run once at the end of the project
A result that looks fine has passed its quality gate
assessmentOpportunities: Write the six stages in order from memory and mark where the two quality gates go
